query: INSERT INTO user_settings (owner_id, timezone, currency, dev_room_id, max_history_turns, briefing_enabled, briefing_time, tts_voice, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (owner_id) DO UPDATE SET timezone = excluded.timezone, currency = excluded.currency, dev_room_id = excluded.dev_room_id, max_history_turns = excluded.max_history_turns, briefing_enabled = excluded.briefing_enabled, briefing_time = excluded.briefing_time, tts_voice = excluded.tts_voice, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
